top_signals.title: SONAR Pricing Power Index Slips to 70 as Intermodal Contract Rates Fall
top_signals.summary:
The SONAR Pricing Power Index fell to 70 this week as intermodal contract rates and ocean bookings softened. Truckload rejections held near 13.9%.
